$ labctl status
=== Cluster ===
  Context:  k3d-contract
  Server:   https://127.0.0.1:<port>
  Version:  v1.33.6+k3s1
  Nodes:    2
  Profile:  k3d

  ! fs.inotify.max_user_instances is 128; the lab needs 512. A Docker VM restart
    resets it. The next lab, platform, scenario, incident or traffic command
    raises it.
  ! k3d-clitest-agent-0 is NotReady while its container is up.
    k3s logged "too many open files".

  Recover with:
    for n in $(docker ps --filter label=k3d.cluster=clitest --format '{{.Names}}'); do
      docker exec "$n" sysctl -w fs.inotify.max_user_instances=512
    done
    docker restart k3d-clitest-agent-0

  Ingress:  traefik  [no workloads]
  Metrics:  prometheus  [no workloads]
